spans.s: दभ्, and दम्भ् दम्भ्, i. 1, दभ, ii. 5, दभ्नु,

. To hurt (ved.).
 2. To deceive.
 --Comp. [] ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-दाभ्य, Not to be checked, Bhāg.

.
 --† i. 10, दाभय, and दम्भय, Par. To send, to impel.
 --† दम्भय, Ātm. To gather.
 --Cf. probably θάμβος, ἔταϕον, τέθηπα; O.H.G. tepjan or depjan.
दभ् + र, adj. Little, insignificant, Bhāg.
